licence_note: FIgLib carries no SPDX licence and requires a credit reference. It is used for EVALUATION ONLY and never for training -- test_no_figlib_in_training enforces that, and it is what makes every Californian number cross-network out-of-sample by construction.
url_note: Frame URL = base_url + sequence_id + '/' + frame, with '+' percent-encoded as %2B.
catalogue: 521 sequences published; 400 span the canonical +/-2400 s at 60 s cadence.
selection: The 20 sequences the Sep 1 separability gate drew its smoke boxes from are MANDATORY members of DEV. They were looked at by a human during the gate, so they can never be HOLD -- the 'fetching is not reading' discipline applied to the gate itself.
Filled to 30 from the same 17 cameras, newest first, so DEV's camera footprint stays tight and HOLD has more cameras left to be disjoint from.

20251102_ScissorsFire_tp-s-mobo-c was in the gate's smoke set but its FIgLib window is not canonical (it does not span +/-2400 s), so it is not a DEV member. It is not a HOLD member either, so nothing the gate saw can reach the headline.
sha256_note: Per-file sha256 is NOT in this manifest and that is deliberate: hashing 10,935 images requires downloading them, which is what scripts/fetch.py does. On the first fetch it writes data/fetch_receipt.json with a sha256 per file; that receipt is committed and every later fetch verifies against it. The manifest pins WHICH frames; the receipt pins WHAT they contained.
